plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp boxing plan with an endurance-first bias using only bodyweight. Week 1 establishes simple baseline strength markers on the main bodyweight lifts so later blocks can progress from real numbers, and the main training work starts in Week 2. The block builds aerobic capacity, repeat-effort conditioning, trunk stiffness, and enough strength and power to support boxing without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build aerobic base, repeat-effort conditioning, basic bodyweight strength, and simple explosive qualities with clean technique.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress conditioning density and bodyweight strength while keeping power work crisp and recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep endurance strong while expressing faster, sharper boxing-specific speed and repeat-burst output.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few easy sets, then perform one hard clean set stopping only when form breaks. Use the same full range each rep and log the total reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor push-ups are not yet clean for multiple reps. Keep the body straight and lower under control.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then perform one hardest clean set. Log the reps and setup used so future progress has a real baseline.

exercises.name: 1a. Snap Down to Stick
exercises.notes: Drop fast, land quietly, and freeze the landing for one second.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump to Stick
substitutionOptions.notes: Jump straight up, land softly, and hold the landing.

exercises.name: 1b. Front Plank
exercises.notes: Brace hard, ribs down, and keep the hips level.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber Intervals
exercises.notes: Steady, repeatable work. Do not sprint the first rounds.

endurancePrescription.intensity: Moderate and nasal-breathing friendly early, harder only in the final rounds
endurancePrescription.target: Whole-body work capacity and aerobic support with low equipment demand
endurancePrescription.notes: Alternate mountain climbers and fast shadowboxing each round.

circuitPrescription.targetAreaEmphasis: Roughly 60% general conditioning and 40% trunk and shoulder endurance

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few easy sets, then perform one hard clean set per side using bodyweight only. Stop when depth or balance breaks down and log reps for both legs.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if rear-foot-elevated work is too unstable. Keep the torso tall and use the same depth each rep.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then perform one hardest clean set per side. Log the reps for left and right so future progress has a baseline.

endurancePrescription.target: Aerobic base and recovery support

substitutionOptions.notes: Use this only if no safe row setup is available. Pause each rep on the floor.
